args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was **unhealthy**; the most recent release that was **healthy in production** was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed `rolled_out` with v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0" describing the failure and the rollback. (The initial call timed out, but I verified via `list_incidents` that it was created successfully.)

**Post-rollback verification:**
- checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
